title: Enrichment
description: One document of the Enrichment Store (collection enrichments): what one enricher produced for one scene of one scene set, under one fingerprint. Written only by the enrichment step; read by the scene-api role of the extraction service. An empty segments array is a valid output: the scene offered the enricher nothing.

_id.description: Data version of the record: hash(scene set version + scene index + enricher + fingerprint).

scene_set_version.description: Data version of the scene set the scene belongs to (Scene Store _id).

asset_version.description: Content hash of the asset version (Asset Registry _id), denormalised for liveness and purge queries.

enricher.description: Name of the enricher: 'description', 'transcript', or a later one.

classification.description: Data classification of the text the enricher produces.

model.description: The model that produced the segments, pinned by digest.

segments.description: Semantic segments in stream order; empty when the scene gave the enricher nothing.

datetime.description: UTC timestamp. Stored as a BSON date; rendered as RFC 3339 in JSON samples.

segment.description: A span of the scene, in stream seconds, with the text attributed to it.

language.description: Language code of the text, when the enricher detects one.

confidence.description: The enricher's confidence in the text, when it reports one.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the enricher: its hyperparameters, output-defining code and model digest.

inputs.description: Data versions read: the scene set first, then every derivative the enricher read.

image.description: Digest of the service image, when known.
